title: Action Surge
html:
For the achievement, see Action Surge.
Action Surge is a free action gained by Fighters at Level 2. This ability allows the fighter to take another action in the same turn.

Description

Immediately gain an extra  Action to use this turn.

Available only in combat.

Properties

Details
 Range: Self
 Recharge: Short rest

Technical details

UID
Shout_ActionSurge

Condition: Action Surge

 Action Surge

Duration: 1 turn

  • Can take an extra Action this turn.

How to learn

Classes:
  • Class level 2: Fighter

Used by creatures: Aradin, Baretha, Breaker of War, Cairos, Cragbender, Dror Ragzlin, Gyldro Angleiron, Hogi Nuners, Karcen, Nestor, Orgarth, Pollo the Muscle, Pumler Grejit, Thrinn, Voss, and Vrak

Notes

  • This action ends  Invisibility and  Hiding. For more details, see notes on invisiblity.
